## Verification

- [ ] `cargo fmt` clean
- [ ] `cargo clippy --no-deps` produces no new warnings
- [ ] `cargo test` passes locally
- [ ] If a rule was added: positive and negative test fixtures exist
- [ ] If a struct shared between BPF and userspace was touched: layout
      assertions still hold and `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` sync points are honored
- [ ] `docs/` updated where applicable
